metadata.title: गोवारी आदिवासियों से क्यों छिना आरक्षण? Interview with Rameshkumar Gajbe।Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Supreme Court of India recently denied Scheduled Tribe status to Gowari tribe of Maharashtra. Earlier, in 2018 the Mumbai High Court had ruled in favour of this tribe, but the Maharashtra government challeneged the order in the apex court. Rameshkumar Baburaoji Gajbe, a prominent tribal leader from Gadhchiroli, Maharashtra explains the details and politics behind this issue in an interview with Main Bhi Bharat.
